name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
✨ Glossy Glassmorphic UI: High-blur liquid specular acrylic popup cards
📱 Display & Screen Layout Fix: 100% responsive across all phone display sizes with zero text clipping
💡 Mobile Cookie Guide & 1-Tap Auto-Adjuster for Android phones
⚡ Smart Chapter Splitting: auto-detect chapters, 1-tap trim or download all as separate tracks
🍪 Netscape & Session Cookies: unlock age-restricted, private, and members-only videos
💬 Subtitles & Captions: extract .srt/.vtt caption tracks alongside media downloads
⚡ Multi-Download Queue: configurable parallel worker threads (1, 2, 3, 5 concurrent)
🏷️ Custom Filename Pattern: dynamic tags ({title}, {author}, {quality}, {date}) with live preview
🚀 Native In-App APK Auto-Updater: seamless update notifications, progress tracking & direct install
